definitions.explanation: The addition of sugar to a food or drink product. Used as a label and modifier to indicate that sugar has been added.

examples.japanese: {加糖|かとう}⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{加糖|かとう}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is this drink sweetened or unsweetened?

examples.japanese: {加糖|かとう}⟦{練乳|れんにゅう}→練乳：21061_rennyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かき{氷|ごおり}→かき氷：10300_kakigoori⟧や⟦いちご→いちご：01028_ichigo⟧⟦にかけて→〜にかけて：30530_nikakete⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Sweetened condensed milk is often poured over shaved ice or strawberries.

notes:
A compound of {加|か} (add) and {糖|とう} (sugar). Primarily used as a prefix or label on food and beverage products to indicate that sugar has been added.

USAGE:
Most commonly encountered on product labels and in food/drink descriptions. Often contrasted with ⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧ (sugar-free) or ⟦{微糖|びとう}→微糖：19896_bitou⟧ (lightly sweetened).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {加糖|かとう}⟦{練乳|れんにゅう}→練乳：21061_rennyuu⟧ — sweetened condensed milk
- {加糖|かとう}⟦ヨーグルト→ヨーグルト：11133_yooguruto⟧ — sweetened yogurt
- {加糖|かとう}⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧ — sweetened beverage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧ — sugar-free, unsweetened (opposite)
- ⟦{微糖|びとう}→微糖：19896_bitou⟧ — lightly sweetened (common on canned coffee)
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ — sweet (general adjective, not limited to added sugar)
